definition_zh: 平分；二等分；把……分成两半；与……相交（几合用法）
definition_en: to divide something into two equal parts, especially with a line
core_image: 一刀把蛋糕切成完全相等的两半
scene: 砖墙尽头有一座八角亭。The new road bisects the old market square.
sceneCN: 这里 bisect 是「从中间穿过、把……分成两半」（第 1 个义项：将整体平分为二）；句意是新马路把老市场广场一分为二。

derivatives.zh: bisect 加 -ion，义为「平分；二等分」
bisect 加 -or，义为「平分线；平分角线」
同族词，义为「解剖；剖析」，同出 secare「切」

senses.title: To divide into two equal parts
senses.definition: to cut or divide into two exactly equal parts
senses.definitionCN: 切分或划分为完全相等的两份
senses.example: The new road bisects the old market square.
senses.exampleCN: 新马路把老市场广场一分为二。
senses.why: Latin bi- means two and secare means to cut: cut in two.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 bi- 意为「二」，secare 意为「切」，合即「切成两半」。

senses.title: To divide an angle equally
senses.definition: in geometry, to divide an angle into two equal angles
senses.definitionCN: 几何学中把角分为两个相等的角
senses.example: The dashed line bisects the corner angle.
senses.why: Equal cutting is the geometer's daily task.
senses.whyCN: 等分切割是几何学的日常功课。

senses.title: To cross through the middle
senses.definition: to pass through the central part of an area
senses.definitionCN: 从某一区域的中央部位穿过
senses.example: A tree-lined avenue bisects the campus.
senses.exampleCN: 一条林荫大道从校园中央穿过。
senses.why: A line through the middle visually halves the space.
senses.whyCN: 穿过中央的线在视觉上把空间一分为二。

senses.title: To halve a period or quantity
senses.definition: to cut a span or amount into two equal stretches
senses.definitionCN: 把时间或数量切成相等的两段
senses.example: The intermission bisects the three-hour opera.
senses.exampleCN: 中场休息把三小时的歌剧分成两半。
senses.why: Time, like space, can be cut at its midpoint.
senses.whyCN: 时间与空间一样，可在中点切开。

senses.title: To divide a group or opinion
senses.titleCN: 使群体或意见分裂为二
senses.definition: to split a body of people or opinion into two halves
senses.definitionCN: 使人群或舆论分成对等的两派
senses.example: The referendum bisected the nation almost exactly.
senses.exampleCN: 公投几乎把国家精确地分成两半。
senses.why: Division of land figures division of minds.
senses.whyCN: 土地之分映射人心之分。

senses.title: To intersect as one of two
senses.definition: of two things, each to cut the other
senses.example: The two paths bisect each other at the bridge.
senses.exampleCN: 两条小径在桥边互相交切。
senses.why: Mutual cutting is rare but possible.
senses.whyCN: 互相切割虽少见，却也成立。

senses.title: In anatomy and surveying
senses.definition: to cut a specimen or plot along its midline
senses.definitionCN: 沿中线切开标本或地块
senses.example: The lab bisected the fruit to show the seed pattern.
senses.exampleCN: 实验室把果实对切以展示籽粒分布。
senses.whyCN: 沿中线切开展示内部结构。

senses.title: In logic of time
senses.definition: to mark the exact middle point of an era or process
senses.definitionCN: 标示时代或进程的精确中点
senses.example: The war bisects the century's story.
senses.exampleCN: 那场战争把世纪的故事一分为二。
senses.whyCN: 历史同样有自己的中线。

intro.en: Bisect is modern Latin bi-, two, plus secare, to cut.
intro.cn: bisect 是近代拉丁构词 bi-「二」加 secare「切」。

items.en: dwo- meant two; sek- meant to cut; reconstructed forms.
items.cn: dwo- 意为「二」；sek- 意为「切」（重构形式）。

items.en: bi- meant two; secare meant to cut.
bisectus, cut in two, was coined for geometry.
items.cn: 近代拉丁语 bisectus「切成两半」为几何学而造。

items.en: English took bisect in the 17th century as a geometric term.
items.cn: 英语于 17 世纪借入 bisect 作几何术语。

items.en: now used from geometry to city planning.
items.cn: 如今用于几何乃至城市规划。

note.en: The look-alike group shares bi- or sect- roots; the near-meaning group gathers dividing words.
note.cn: 形近组共享 bi- 或 sect- 词根；近义组汇集分割类词。

entries.definitionCN: 解剖；剖析——同根 dis-（分开）

entries.definition: a six-legged creature, cut into sections
entries.definitionCN: 昆虫——同根，本义「切分之体」

entries.definition: to divide into three equal parts

normalIntro.en: Bisect is bi- (two) plus secare (cut): cut into two.
normalIntro.cn: bisect 是 bi-（二）加 secare（切）：切成两份。

normal.en: A bisector is the cutting line.
Roads and rivers can bisect cities.
normal.cn: 路与河都可把城市一分为二。

abstract.en: See the blade meet the exact middle.
Feel two halves balance in the pans.
abstract.cn: 感受两半在天平两端持平。

abstract.en: Picture a dashed line through a circle's heart.
abstract.cn: 想象一条虚线穿过圆心。

examples.en: The new road bisects the old market square.
examples.cn: 新马路把老市场广场一分为二。

examples.en: The dashed line bisects the corner angle.
The referendum bisected the nation almost exactly.
examples.cn: 公投几乎把国家精确地分成两半。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「掰·塞克特」——掰成两半塞克特（sect＝切），一刀两断不多不少。

root: 拉丁语 bi-「二」（上溯原始印欧语 dwo-，重构形式）加 secare「切」（上溯原始印欧语 sek-「切」，重构形式）；近代拉丁语 bisectus「切成两半」，17 世纪进入英语作几何术语，现代扩展至城市、时间与舆论之「平分」。

sensesIntro.en: One cut in two reaches from geometry to cities, history, and divided nations.
sensesIntro.cn: 「一切为二」从几何延伸到城市、历史与分裂的国家。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: the knife meeting the exact middle
core.cn: 核心意象：刀锋落在精确的中点

branches.en: Lines and roads through the middle

intro.en: Bisect pairs a number prefix with a cutting root.
intro.cn: bisect 由数词前缀配切割词根。

latinIntro.en: The secare family in Latin and English.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 secare 词族及其英语后裔。
